notes.title: BUG FIX: "Second Select Mode" for explosive towers on start has been fixed
notes.notes: The second select mode toggle for explosive towers has been fixed! It was completely buggy because I accidentally put it in the Start method rather than OnEnable which checks EVERY time a tower is spawned, rather than just the first time. This was a technical and literary mistake, as Start seemed like the correct function in the heat of the moment lol.
